context.content_translation:
技术人员通知 Becker 先生，他的笔记本电脑需要根据保修期进行维修。
A. require
B. decide
C. insist
D. notify

items.question: The technician informed Mr. Becker that his laptop would --- a repair covered under the warranty.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“require”代入题干后为“The technician informed Mr. Becker that his laptop would require a repair covered under the warranty.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：A（require）。
